notes: One block per element. prerequisites: the element is not barred by a Disable (elements_not_disabled with the element as a one-item literal list) and the caster has a positive stat behind it. effects: emission power stat_of(caster, element), resist power stat_of(defender, element), the element's Rule 21 delta max0(emit - resist), the point-buy dice for it, and its stat column. validation: stat unchanged and resolving to a stats entry that lists this element, id among valid_element_ids, color_hint a string. Effect-usage counts are over the active versions of effects.json on 2026-10-28.

elem_vitality.description: Vitality element (red-flesh), powered by stat_vitality: emitted with the caster's Vitality and resisted with the defender's Vitality (Rule 18); its delta feeds the Rule 21 damage sum; its point-buy rolls point_buy_dice_count(vitality) dice. Used by 16 effects: Super Sense, Super Force, Harm, Sound Wave, Drain, Emotions Bombard, Potion Brew, Nature Embrace, Resurrect / Death Ward, Fossilization, Inner Fire, Phantom, Possess / Phylactery, Poison, Turn Life, Petrify. Force Shield's Vitality die is subtracted from the incoming effect sum (pc).

prerequisites.description: No Disable bars Vitality for the caster.
The caster's Vitality is above 0.

effects.description: Emission power: the caster's Vitality.
Resistance: the defender's Vitality.
Stat points this element adds to the Rule 21 sum.
Dice a point-buy of this element rolls.
The stat entry behind the element.

validation.description: The element keeps its stat column.
The stat entry exists and lists this element.
The element id is one of the ten.
color_hint stays a non-empty string.
